project_specification.project_name: Scholium — outlined Scholium Display wordmark in the logo lockup
project_specification.addition_summary: The wordmark in the Scholium logo lockup changes from the word "scholium" typed in Source Serif 4 semibold to outline artwork drawn from Scholium Display Bold (docs/brand/type/fonts/ScholiumDisplay-Bold.otf). The brand source is already updated: docs/brand/scholium-wordmark.json holds the wordmark path in the 52 x 54 BrandMark grid (view box 0 0 286.99 54, pen origin x 66.04), docs/brand/scholium-lockup-light.svg and -dark.svg are the reference lockups, docs/brand/scholium-lockup-light.png, -dark.png and -email.png are the renders, and docs/design.md section 2 describes the rules (x-height 0.46 of the lockup height, baseline 0.205 above its bottom edge, gap 0.26, ascenders level with the top of the page block). This addition carries that wordmark into the web app's BrandLogo, the social share cards and the notification e-mail header. The mark itself, the colours, sizes and clear space do not change, and Scholium Display is never served as a font: the wordmark is a path.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 FastAPI API in apps/api (uv workspace); Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind web app in apps/web (npm workspaces). The lockup is BrandLogo (apps/web/src/features/ui-kit/brand-logo.tsx, brand.css): the BrandMark glyph SVG followed by a span.sch-brand-logo__wordmark holding the text "scholium" in var(--family-serif) at weight 600, sized with font-size-adjust and aligned by baseline. The social share cards (apps/web/src/features/ui-kit/brand-card.tsx) are drawn with Satori (next/og) from static WOFF files in features/ui-kit/og-fonts and set the wordmark as Source Serif 4 text. The notification e-mail header (apps/api/src/app/modules/notifications/email_template.py) is a 32px PNG mark plus "scholium" as serif text. apps/web/public/brand/scholium-logo-light.png and -dark.png are PNG renders of the lockup that manifest.test.ts checks for even padding.
existing_context.test_baseline: Not re-measured for this spec; the acceptance gate measures npm test at the start of the run. Playwright journeys (npm run test:e2e) include tests/e2e/branding.spec.ts, which asserts .sch-brand-logo__wordmark has text "scholium" and computed colour equal to the ink token in light and dark mode.
existing_context.conventions: Feature code in apps/web/src/features/<feature>/ with colocated *.test.ts(x); never hardcode a hex in a component (read CSS custom properties from tokens.css); docs/design.md is the UI authority and docs/brand is the brand source of truth

feature.description: System provides the outlined wordmark to the web app: apps/web/src/features/ui-kit/wordmark.ts exports WORDMARK = { viewBox: [0, 0, 286.99, 54], penOriginX: 66.04, path } with the path string copied verbatim from docs/brand/scholium-wordmark.json and a header comment naming docs/brand/build_lockup.py as its generator; apps/web/public/brand/scholium-logo-light.png and scholium-logo-dark.png are replaced by byte-identical copies of docs/brand/scholium-lockup-light.png and scholium-lockup-dark.png (1200 x 380, 95 px padding on every side), and apps/web/public/brand/scholium-lockup-email.png is created as a byte-identical copy of docs/brand/scholium-lockup-email.png; wordmark.test.ts passes when WORDMARK.path and WORDMARK.viewBox equal the values in docs/brand/scholium-wordmark.json and the three PNGs equal their docs/brand sources byte for byte, and the existing "the logo lockups" tests in apps/web/src/app/manifest.test.ts still pass against the new PNGs

UI displays the BrandLogo lockup with the outlined Scholium Display Bold wordmark instead of Source Serif 4 text: brand-logo.tsx keeps the span.sch-brand-logo__wordmark element (aria-hidden, colour var(--ink)) but its content becomes an inline SVG with viewBox "66.04 0 220.95 54" (from WORDMARK.penOriginX to the wordmark's right edge), the same height as the mark, one path with d equal to WORDMARK.path and fill "currentColor", and a title element reading "scholium" so the element's text content stays "scholium"; brand.css drops the font-family, font-weight, font-size-adjust and baseline-offset rules that set the serif text, keeps the flex gap of 0.26 of the mark height, sizes the wordmark SVG to the mark height with width 220.95/54 of it and aligns both SVGs by their top edge, so the rendered lockup matches docs/brand/scholium-lockup-light.svg (ascenders level with the top of the page block, baseline 0.205 of the height above the bottom); the lockup keeps role img, aria-label "Scholium", the sm/md/lg sizes (20/28/48 px mark height) and its token colours in light and dark mode; brand.test.tsx passes when it finds the path equal to WORDMARK.path, the viewBox above, the title "scholium", and no serif family on the wordmark element

System renders the social share cards (/opengraph-image and /p/[id]/opengraph-image return HTTP 200 with a 1200x630 PNG) with the outlined wordmark: brand-card.tsx draws the lockup's wordmark as an svg element containing a path with d equal to WORDMARK.path in the resolved ink colour, at the scale of the card's glyph (one grid unit is markHeight/54, so the wordmark is 220.95/54 x markHeight wide, placed 0.26 x markHeight after the glyph, top edges aligned), in place of the Source Serif 4 text node; BRAND_CARD_WORDMARK stays "scholium" and still feeds the image alt text; paper titles still use Source Serif 4; brand-card.test.tsx passes when the card trees contain the wordmark path and no text node "scholium" inside the lockup, and og-fonts/README.md no longer lists the wordmark as a use of source-serif-4-semibold.woff

System sends notification e-mails whose header displays the lockup as one image: email_template.py replaces the 32 px PNG mark plus the serif "scholium" text cell with a single img of {web origin}/brand/scholium-lockup-email.png with width 170, height 32, alt "Scholium", border 0 and display block, on the existing paper background; the plain-text body and the rest of the HTML body are unchanged; test_email_template.py passes when the header contains that img with those attributes and no serif font-family remains in the header

project_specification.integration_points: New module apps/web/src/features/ui-kit/wordmark.ts, imported by brand-logo.tsx and brand-card.tsx (not exported from the ui-kit index) BrandLogo is used unchanged by the global navigation, the homepage, the (web-auth) layout and the root not-found and error pages; they pick up the new wordmark without edits The share-card route handlers (opengraph-image.tsx files) keep calling brand-card.tsx unchanged The notification e-mail header loads /brand/scholium-lockup-email.png from the web origin, like the mark it replaces
project_specification.constraints: docs/brand and docs/design.md are already updated and are the source of truth; do not modify them, and never edit or regenerate the wordmark path in the app (it is copied from docs/brand/scholium-wordmark.json) The BrandMark glyph and tile geometry, the favicon and manifest icons, the colours, sizes and clear space stay unchanged No Scholium Display font file is added to apps/web or served to browsers or e-mail clients; the wordmark is a path Components read colours from CSS custom properties in apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css; no new hex literals in components (the share card and e-mail HTML may embed brand hex values as today) No new runtime dependencies npm test stays green, and npm run test:e2e stays green without editing tests/e2e/branding.spec.ts or tests/e2e/home.spec.ts
project_specification.success_criteria: The global navigation, sign-in, onboarding, recovery, not-found and error screens show the lockup with the outlined Scholium Display Bold wordmark, matching docs/brand/scholium-lockup-light.svg and -dark.svg Shared links show share cards whose lockup uses the outlined wordmark Notification e-mails show the lockup image in the header and keep an unchanged plain-text body npm test and npm run test:e2e stay green
